systemFindings.finding: learningStatus assigns MASTERED after one high-scoring attempt. Does not verify stability over multiple independent checks.
nextTopicForSubject uses status and sortOrder; TopicDependency is not an enforced prerequisite guard.
plan window, study days and daily minutes are used; examDate and targetScore are not inputs to topic selection in this path.
MATCHING/SEQUENCE grade as whole-question correctness. Not official NMT partial-point scoring.
Official history three-of-seven and biology three-group answer formats are not supported by the import schema. Do not claim full official mock coverage.

forecast: No guaranteed score, no 180–200 prediction from small thematic tests.
